+"""SQLite persistence for users."""
+
+import sqlite3
+
+_conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", check_same_thread=False)
+_conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
+_conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)")
+_conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name, email) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", [
+    (1, "Ada Lovelace", "ada@example.com"),
+    (2, "Linus Torvalds", "linus@example.com"),
+    (3, "Grace Hopper", "grace@example.com"),
+])
+_conn.commit()
+
+
+def _to_dict(row):
+    return dict(row) if row else None
+
+
+def get_by_id(user_id: int) -> dict | None:
+    return _to_dict(_conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)).fetchone())
+
+
+def find_by_email(email: str) -> dict | None:
+    return _to_dict(_conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email,)).fetchone())
+
+
+def update_name(user_id: int, name: str) -> dict | None:
+    """Store a new name for the user, returning the updated row or None if missing."""
+    cur = _conn.execute("UPDATE users SET name = ? WHERE id = ?", (name, user_id))
+    _conn.commit()
+    if cur.rowcount == 0:
+        return None
+    return get_by_id(user_id)

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_MAX_NAME_LENGTH = 50
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_rename_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw_id = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw_id, str) or not raw_id.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+
+    raw_name = params.get("name")
+    if not isinstance(raw_name, str):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid name"}
+    name = raw_name.strip()
+    if not 1 <= len(name) <= _MAX_NAME_LENGTH:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid name"}
+
+    user = users.rename_user(int(raw_id), name)
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user

+from app.api.handlers import handle_get_user, handle_rename_user
+
+
+def test_get_user_ok():
+    assert handle_get_user({"id": "1"}) == (200, {"id": 1, "name": "Ada Lovelace", "email": "ada@example.com"})
+
+
+def test_get_user_invalid():
+    assert handle_get_user({"id": "abc"})[0] == 400
+
+
+def test_get_user_missing():
+    assert handle_get_user({"id": "99"})[0] == 404
+
+
+def test_rename_user_ok_and_visible():
+    status, user = handle_rename_user({"id": "2", "name": "Linus Updated"})
+    assert status == 200
+    assert user == {"id": 2, "name": "Linus Updated", "email": "linus@example.com"}
+    assert handle_get_user({"id": "2"}) == (200, {"id": 2, "name": "Linus Updated", "email": "linus@example.com"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_trims_whitespace():
+    status, user = handle_rename_user({"id": "3", "name": "  Grace T  "})
+    assert status == 200
+    assert user["name"] == "Grace T"
+    assert handle_get_user({"id": "3"})[1]["name"] == "Grace T"
+
+
+def test_rename_user_invalid_id():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"name": "Whatever"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": 1, "name": "Whatever"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "abc", "name": "Whatever"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_invalid_id_checked_before_name():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "abc", "name": ""}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_invalid_name():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "1"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "1", "name": 123}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "1", "name": ""}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "1", "name": "   "}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "1", "name": "x" * 51}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_name_checked_before_existence():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "99", "name": ""}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_not_found():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "99", "name": "Nobody"}) == (404, {"error": "not found"})
